mission: Invariant/counterfactual robustness sweep of stroke-heuristic-6 (packages/swing-lab/src/strokeHeuristic.ts + the Lite copy): systematic perturbations of existing NON-holdout fixtures, measuring label stability, abstention-reason stability, and dangerous confident-label-to-different-confident-label flips; pin real invariant violations as regression tests.
method: Deterministic perturbation sweep (datasets/experiments/wave-g/g14-h6-invariants-sweep.ts) over the 18 evaluable committed wave-a bench rows (the same rows as strokeHeuristicBench: committed pose slices in datasets/paddle-bench/runs-wave-a scored against datasets/paddle-bench/stroke-gold.json). Each row is re-classified under 33 perturbation variants across 6 families; wrist-speed inputs are recomputed from each perturbed sequence; both the lab classifier and the Lite copy run on every evaluation and are checked for exact parity. Seeds are content-hash derived (FNV) + LCG, fully reproducible. Outcomes per evaluation: stable_label, stable_abstain, abstain_reason_changed, label_to_abstain, abstain_to_label, confident_label_flip (committed label -> DIFFERENT committed label).

datasetScope.grouping: by corpus sessionKey (5 groups: dvids-marne-2024, dvids-faead-2024, dvids-944403, dvids-wgm-wheelchair, dvids-sasebo-volleys)
datasetScope.goldSource: datasets/paddle-bench/stroke-gold.json (Gold, human-annotated; machine labels were never used as truth)

holdoutStatement: The held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were never touched, read, listed, or referenced. Only committed wave-a bench fixtures (STROKE_BENCH_POSE_CASES) were perturbed.

perturbationFamilies.torso: hip-y extent scaled x0.92/x0.96/x1.04/x1.08 plus shoulder-y counterparts (6 variants)
perturbationFamilies.crop: zoom x1.1/x1.25 about frame center + translation +-0.05 in x and y (6 variants)
perturbationFamilies.framerate: keep-1-of-2 (2 phases) and keep-1-of-3 (3 phases) frame decimation (5 variants)
perturbationFamilies.noise: i.i.d. Gaussian coordinate noise sigma 0.002/0.005/0.01 u, 3 seeds each (9 variants)
perturbationFamilies.dropout: random landmark dropout p=0.05/0.1/0.2, 3 seeds spread over 6 variants
perturbationFamilies.reflect: left/right mirror: x -> 1-x, left/right joint names swapped, declared handedness flipped (1 variant)

detail: wavea-faead-rally@13417/target: FOREHAND(0.60) -> BACKHAND(0.60) under noise sigma=0.002 (2 seeds), 0.005 (1 seed), 0.01 (1 seed) — 4 flips; baseline dominant/rival wrist travel ratio 1.27
wavea-944403-dink@21500/other: FOREHAND(0.80) -> BACKHAND(0.60) under noise sigma=0.005 (2 seeds), 0.01 (1 seed) and fps keep-1-of-3 (1 phase) — 4 flips; baseline travel ratio 1.16
dangerousFlips.rootCause: The dominant wrist is an argmax over comparative +-200ms travel. On rows whose two wrists have nearly-tied travels AND sit on opposite sides of the torso midline, sub-pixel noise or resampling swaps the argmax, and the swap mirrors the side call at UNCHANGED confidence.

after_fix_stroke_heuristic_7.baselineCoverageCost: Exactly 2 of 18 baseline rows moved committed -> abstained under the new gate: wavea-faead-rally@13417/target (v6 committed FOREHAND 0.60 — WRONG vs gold backhand) and wavea-944403-dink@21500/other (v6 committed FOREHAND 0.80 — gold L2 unknown, unverifiable). Zero gold-correct commits were lost.

fix.description: stroke-heuristic-7 adds one gate (both copies: packages/swing-lab/src/strokeHeuristic.ts and packages/vision-geometry/src/strokeHeuristicLite.ts): when both wrists have >= MIN_TRAVEL_SAMPLE_FRAMES measured frames, their +-200ms travels are within DOMINANT_WRIST_NEAR_TIE_RATIO (1.35), AND the two wrists sit on opposite sides of the torso midline (the configuration in which the argmax swap mirrors the side call), abstain with reason dominant_wrist_near_tie_across_midline_side_attribution_unstable. The gate runs AFTER the symmetric-bimanual gate so wheelchair rim propulsion keeps its more specific diagnosis. Two-handed backhands also tie on travel but keep both hands on ONE grip (same side of the midline), so the midline counterfactual keeps them committing (existing test holds).
fix.thresholdAnchors: 1.35 separates the two measured flip-prone rows (ratios 1.16, 1.27) from the smallest correctly-committed one-armed row (marne-serve, 1.45). Documented anchor, not a calibrated statistic; the gate was designed once from the sweep's root cause, not tuned iteratively against it.
fix.regressionTests: packages/swing-lab/test/strokeHeuristicNearTie.redteam.test.ts — near-tie opposite-side fixture must abstain (lab + Lite, exact parity), and a clearly one-armed control (ratio ~5) must still commit FOREHAND.

findings: DANGEROUS INSTABILITY (found, then closed): 8/594 evaluations under stroke-heuristic-6 flipped a confident committed side to the OPPOSITE confident side (FOREHAND->BACKHAND) under sigma=0.002-0.01u coordinate noise or 10-15fps decimation; root cause was the noise-decided dominant-wrist argmax on near-tied travels with wrists straddling the midline. stroke-heuristic-7 abstains on that configuration; the post-fix sweep measures 0/594 dangerous flips.
REFLECTION INVARIANCE HELD: 18/18 left/right-mirrored rows produced the physically-expected outcome (mirrored side with flipped handedness / identical abstention reason); 0 violations.
TORSO EXTENT PERTURBATION HELD: 108/108 evaluations stable (0 reason changes, 0 transitions) under +-4-8% extent scaling.

ABSTENTION-REASON INSTABILITY (open): 134/594 post-fix evaluations abstain with a DIFFERENT reason than baseline (concentrated in dropout 51/108, noise 48/162, framerate 31/90). Labels stay honest (still abstentions) but the reported reason is not a robust diagnostic under measurement degradation.

NOISE CAN MANUFACTURE CLAIMS (open): 9/594 post-fix evaluations turn a baseline abstention into a committed label (7 noise, 1 framerate, 1 dropout), e.g. wavea-sasebo-volleys@51900/target no_swing_energy_in_window -> FOREHAND(0.80) under sigma=0.005 noise: added coordinate noise inflates apparent wrist travel/energy past commitment floors. These are perturbation-manufactured commits, not baseline behavior, and were NOT 'fixed' by threshold tuning — documented as a known open robustness gap.
PRE-EXISTING confidently-wrong baseline commit (out of scope, unchanged): wavea-wgm-wheelchair@182400/target commits FOREHAND(0.80) vs gold backhand at baseline; not perturbation-related.
LAB/LITE PARITY: 0 violations across all 594x2 evaluations, before and after the fix.
rationale: The sweep found a real, dangerous invariant violation (8/594 confident side flips under small perturbations) in stroke-heuristic-6, root-caused it to the near-tie dominant-wrist argmax, and closed it with a principled abstention gate (stroke-heuristic-7) that costs zero gold-correct baseline commits and is pinned by regression tests in both classifier copies; post-fix the dangerous count is 0/594 and reflection/torso invariances held cleanly. YELLOW rather than PROVISIONAL_GREEN because two measured robustness gaps remain open and undisguised: abstention REASONS are unstable under degradation (134/594) and noise can manufacture new confident commits from baseline abstentions (9/594).
artifacts: datasets/experiments/wave-g/g14-h6-invariants-sweep.json (full post-fix report: all 594 evaluations, per-family counts, unlock list)
